label: Excellent
interpretation: Heavy metal concentrations are well below permissible limits and crops are considered very safe for consumption.

label: Good
interpretation: Food is generally safe with only minor contamination concerns.

label: Moderate
interpretation: Food quality is acceptable but continuous monitoring is recommended.

label: Poor
interpretation: Food is approaching the permissible safety limit and consumption should be monitored.

label: Unsafe
interpretation: Heavy metal concentration exceeds WHO permissible limits and food is considered unsafe.
